title: Unverified & Forged JWT Signing Oracle on License Server
description: GET /v1/validate parses JWT using unverified atob() without verifying incoming RSA cryptographic signatures, and re-signs near-expiry claims with server private key, creating an arbitrary enterprise token signing oracle.
remediation: Verify incoming JWT with env.JWT_PUBLIC_KEY before inspecting claims, check Cloudflare D1 for license revocation, and eliminate automatic re-signing of unverified payloads.

title: Unverified & Stubbed Stripe Webhook Handler
description: POST /v1/webhook/stripe ignores STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, skips stripe-signature verification, and returns a dummy JSON response without persisting purchased licenses to Cloudflare D1.
remediation: Validate Stripe HMAC-SHA256 signature against request body and persist checkout.session.completed transactions to D1 database.

title: NPM Package Dependency Confusion & CLI Installation Implosion
description: @secureship/cli bundles internal packages via tsup, but leaves 9 unpublished private workspace packages in dependencies. npm install -g fails or downloads attacker-registered packages.
remediation: Remove private workspace packages from runtime dependencies in packages/cli/package.json since they are bundled into dist/index.js.

title: Standalone Binaries Missing Bundled WASM Grammars
description: bun build --compile creates standalone binaries without packaging packages/reachability/wasm/*.wasm, causing clean standalone executions to fail with 'WASM directory not found'.
remediation: Package standalone binaries alongside wasm/ directory in tar.gz/zip archives and update wasm-manifest.ts search candidates.

title: Fatal Client-Server Protocol Incompatibility in Background Renewal
description: refreshLicenseInBackground sends HTTP POST with { sub } body and expects data.jwt, whereas license-server handles GET /v1/validate with Authorization Bearer and returns refreshedJwt. Renewal requests 404 and are swallowed, causing licenses to expire.
remediation: Update client to send GET /v1/validate with Bearer header, parse data.refreshedJwt, and verify RSA signature before saving.

title: Wildcard CORS * on Fleet Server Exposes Telemetry and Policy Tampering
description: FleetServer unconditionally sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on all responses, allowing malicious web pages visited by developers or CISOs to make cross-origin requests to unauthenticated endpoints to read corporate telemetry or overwrite security policies.
remediation: Remove wildcard CORS header, restrict CORS to configured enterprise dashboard origins, and enforce Bearer token authentication.

title: Zero Seat Limit Enforcement on License Server / Infinite Activations
description: POST /v1/activate issues RS256 signed JWTs without querying existing activation count in D1 against record.seats, enabling unlimited activations on a single 1-seat license.
remediation: Add transactional COUNT(DISTINCT machine_fingerprint) check against activations table in worker.ts and reject with 403 when seat limit is exceeded.

title: Curated Symbol Dataset & SAST Rules Missing From Shipped Artifacts
description: Runtime symbol reachability and SAST rules resolve via process.cwd() or monorepo relative paths and are omitted from @secureship/cli files in package.json, causing reachability and custom scanning to fail on clean global installations.
remediation: Bundle rules/ and packages/reachability/data inside CLI dist/assets and resolve them using import.meta.url relative to package directory.

title: Fake Remediation Backend in Production Engine
description: When sandbox.backend is 'none', verification ladder instantiates FakeSandboxBackend, which unconditionally returns exit code 0 and certifies unverified code patches as VERIFIED_RUNTIME.
remediation: Delete FakeSandboxBackend from production builds; cap verification ladder at VERIFIED_STATIC when backend is none.

title: Fatal Crash on Subdirectory Monorepo Incremental Git Diff Scans
description: DiffScope expects .git strictly inside targetDir rather than workspace root, throwing an unhandled exception when scanning monorepo subdirectories with --staged.
remediation: Traverse parent directories or invoke git rev-parse --show-toplevel to find git root, and filter diff files by relative path.

title: Fleet Server Token Leak to stdout & Unauthenticated Control Endpoints
description: Fleet server prints FLEET_TOKEN in plaintext to stdout upon startup, and leaves /api/fleet/repos, /api/fleet/summary, and /api/policy unauthenticated.
remediation: Remove plaintext token print from CLI and enforce Authorization: Bearer <FLEET_TOKEN> checks on all Fleet routes.

title: Windows Container Mount Path /c/... Translation Rejection by Docker Desktop
description: ContainerBackend.translateHostPath converts Windows drive paths (C:\...) to /c/..., which Docker Desktop for Windows rejects as an invalid local volume name, breaking container sandbox execution.
remediation: Preserve Windows drive letter formatting with forward slashes (e.g. C:/Users/...) on Windows when building Docker volume arguments.

title: Unsynchronized Non-Atomic fs.writeFileSync in FleetStore Data Loss
description: FleetStore synchronously overwrites its database file in place with fs.writeFileSync; interruptions cause JSON corruption which is swallowed on restart, wiping all fleet repositories and policies.
remediation: Write to a temporary file and atomically rename (fs.renameSync), and add backup file rotation on disk persistence.

title: Prohibited Shell Invocations in License Command
description: License checkout launcher uses child_process.exec() with shell: true, violating architectural safety principles and creating command injection risk on Windows.
remediation: Replace child_process.exec with spawnSafe using shell: false and array arguments.

title: Insecure Temp File Permissions in VSCode Extension Runner
description: VSCode extension creates temporary scan output files in shared os.tmpdir() with default world-readable permissions, leaking findings to other users on multi-user systems.
remediation: Use fs.mkdtempSync to create a restricted temp directory with 0o700 permissions before writing scan files.

title: Completely Stubbed Registry Supply-Chain Risk Provider
description: All 4 methods in RegistryProvider return hardcoded UNAVAILABLE error objects without performing any live HTTP queries to NPM or PyPI registries.
remediation: Implement live HTTP registry client querying npmjs.org and pypi.org with caching and offline fallback.

title: Rebranded Third-Party Scanner Rule IDs Missing Upstream Notices
description: White-labeled upstream scanner engines (Opengrep, Checkov, Trivy) reference container-only license paths in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md that do not exist in binary/npm releases.
remediation: Embed full license texts and copyright notices for all rebranded engines directly inside shipping distributions and root notices file.

title: Anti-Fake-Test Law Integrity Violations in Reachability Suite
description: 4 test cases in hostile-stress.test.ts violate Anti-Fake-Test Laws by asserting on real wall-clock elapsed time or using weak toBeDefined() checks without structural verification.
remediation: Replace weak assertions with strict AST structural comparisons and use deterministic fake timers for performance tests.

title: Windows Path Normalization Inconsistencies in VSCode Runner
description: Inconsistent mixing of forward slashes and backslashes causes diagnostic markers to occasionally fail to attach to open editor tabs on Windows workstations.
remediation: Standardize all internal path comparisons using path.normalize() or POSIX-style paths before matching URIs.
